notes:
Uploads wait for your cards, and a pulled card is explained clearly.

- Uploads start once your cards finish copying, so cards are free sooner
- If an SD card is pulled mid-copy, SafeStore names the card and how many files still need copying, and Resume says what it needs
- "Delivered" only shows once every file has been copied and uploaded
- Eject when verified ejects the card for you once every file matches
- The live file list keeps its place, and the tray icon no longer crashes the app
